run_mtp_training: run the MTP transformer training loop with config file via train.py config=path/to/config.yaml
train_LMTransformer: train an LMTransformer model using the lingua MTP training pipeline with gradient accumulation and checkpointing
validate_TrainArgs: validate TrainArgs configuration including vocab size, data paths, and distributed parallelism settings
build_TrainState: build a TrainState object tracking optimizer steps, accumulation steps, scheduler, and data loader state
checkpoint_MTP_model: save and load MTP model checkpoints with optimizer state, training state, and device mesh via CheckpointManager
